resources.string: Resumes a song paused in the last 30 minutes when Bluetooth or wired headphones connect.
Claude reads the whole song for a natural translation. Falls back to Google Translate if it fails.
Tap to add a Claude API key
Claude refused this key or the account is out of credit, so Google Translate is being used. Tap to check the key.
Create a key under API Keys at platform.claude.com and paste it here. API use is billed to that account. The key stays on this device and is sent only to Anthropic.
Used for lyric translation, song explanations and original-title lookups.
Fast and cheap: about $0.10 per million input tokens, $0.50 per million output. A song costs well under a cent.
More natural translations, about 20× the price: $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output. A song costs about one or two cents.
Applies in any translation language that has casual and polite forms. Changes apply to songs translated from now on; long-press the translate button to redo one.
Changes apply to songs translated from now on; long-press the translate button to redo one.
Estimated from list prices; the Anthropic Console has the exact bill.
These use your own Claude API key and are billed to that account by use. Without a key, lyrics are translated by Google Translate as before.
Sends every song\'s lyrics to Claude in one batch, at half the usual price. The results are not immediate: usually within an hour, at most 24 hours. A notification tells you when they are in.

Won to the dollar, entered by you (%1$d–%2$d). Amounts in won are marked as approximate: the real charge can differ.
A notification when this share of the monthly limit is used, and once more when the limit is reached. Translations ahead still on their way are counted.
Set a monthly limit to use this.
Once what was spent today on translations as you listen reaches this, Google translates until midnight. Translating ahead (Batch) is not counted.
Smaller batches finish sooner, in more parts. Applies to jobs made from now on, and to downloaded songs sent in a batch.

Every translation and pronunciation in the kept store is deleted (%1$s MB). Claude\'s cost money to get again, and downloaded songs show no translation offline until they are. Back them up first under Settings > Back up translations. This cannot be undone.
The saved meanings of %1$d songs (%2$s MB) are deleted. Seeing one again asks Claude again, at a cost. This cannot be undone.
The kept store and song meanings are asked about once more before they go.
The %2$d translations, pronunciations and meanings saved for \"%1$s\" are deleted from the cache and the kept store. Claude\'s cost money to get again. This cannot be undone.
Fetched when the app opens on a new day; the last rate is kept when it cannot be.
The rate below, as you type it.
No key needed. Changes once each business day.
Needs a free key. Changes on business days, around 11 a.m. Korean time.
No rate fetched yet. Until one is, the rate typed by hand (₩%1$s) is used.
Could not fetch the rate. The last one is still used.

Issued free from the Open API menu of the Korea Eximbank website. Kept on this device only, never in a settings export or a backup. Without a key, or when the Eximbank cannot be reached, the ECB rate is used.
Anthropic charges your card in dollars, so the won taken is usually 1–2% more than the base rate. Pick your card\'s overseas fee to add it to amounts in won.
No lyrics source had lyrics for this song when it was last looked up. It is left out of translating ahead, and looked up again after 30 days, or as soon as the player shows lyrics for it.
Its lyrics are looked for again next time it is translated ahead
%1$d already translated are skipped, at no cost.
%1$d with no lyrics are left out.
Nothing to send: every song is translated already or has no lyrics.
Hold the button down to get Claude\'s reading for that one song, whatever is chosen here.
Google\'s romanisation written in Hangul on the phone: aishiteru → 아이시테루. Japanese and Chinese. No cost.
Most accurate, including how kanji are sung. Costs about as much as a translation.
Google\'s Latin letters: aishiteru. No cost.
Sent with every Claude translation, pronunciation and translation ahead. Translations already made stay as they are: hold the translate button to have one made again.

Keep names of people and places, and English words, as they are.
Use casual speech throughout, never formal.
Stay close to the original wording rather than smoothing it out.
In Korean, write 너 for you rather than 당신.

Draws the seek bar as the song\'s waveform: downloaded songs (worked out once, in the background) and songs Automix has analysed. Other songs keep the plain bar.
Songs that aren\'t downloaded get one from the cache once the player has read the whole song ahead, usually within a minute of it starting. No extra data. The latest 3,000 are kept on this phone.
Shows progress as a status bar chip and at the top of the lock screen (Android 16). Whether it appears is up to the system.
Live Updates are off for BitChord in the system settings. Tap to turn them on.

Same song = same title, same version (not live or remix), same artist and a length within 3 seconds. Nothing is removed until you confirm.
They are removed from ‘%1$s’ on YouTube Music. The copy kept of each song stays.

Pick the other uploads of “%1$s”. Once they are grouped, radio and AutoPlay leave the rest out whenever one of them is already in the queue.
Nothing else is in the queue. Open this again from a queue with both songs in it.
Songs already in the queue stay where they are; this applies from the next time radio or AutoPlay adds songs. Kept in the settings backup.
Song background search is on: a song with no background yet has it looked up in the same request, about 30 won more a song, included in the estimate.
Only when the wikis have nothing · one more search
Closer reading, about 70–100 won a song · translate-ahead looks up with its translation model
Looking through the queue with Claude…
Nothing is queued twice. Other languages, covers, live takes and remixes count as other songs.
Nothing is queued twice by the app\'s rules. With a Claude key, uploads under other names are found too.
Claude couldn\'t look just now. Try again in a moment.
%1$d songs are queued more than once. The ticked copies come out.
Radio and AutoPlay leave the others out from now on, without asking Claude. Undo it from the song menu\'s “Same song”.
When radio or AutoPlay adds songs, Claude takes out a recording already queued under another upload · about 1 won a time (Haiku)
New features arrive first, before the stable release. They may have problems.
This is a beta build. Android won\'t install an older version over it, so updates resume once a stable release passes this one.
Radio and AutoPlay put songs you heard through in this period after the new ones.
Heard songs still fill in, longest-unheard first.
Heard songs are left out. Under 3 new ones, the longest-unheard fill in.
On a car or speaker display, the playing line shows in place of the title.

Only while playing to a car or speaker over Bluetooth. The phone’s notification and lock-screen media card show the line too, and other apps that read the notification may log it as the title. Some cars update slowly or not at all.

The ふ button by the pronunciation button puts each kanji word’s reading over it. Claude writes it on the first tap (about 3–6 won a song with Haiku), and it is kept. Songs already done show it by themselves while it is on.
抜錨 → ばつびょう, as Japanese books print it
抜錨 → 바츠뵤, for reading without kana
Japanese songs only: readings over the kanji, at half price (about 2–3 won a song)
Off: only a car, a speaker or a device that names neither
Settings › Other › What’s new after an update turns it back on
Once, on the first launch after updating: the release notes, a page per section
When the rules pick another singer’s cover or no song, Claude chooses the same recording on YouTube Music. About 0.1–0.3 won a song, once.

Once this month\'s estimated cost reaches the limit, Google Translate is used instead of Claude until next month. The estimate is counted by the app from tokens, so it can differ slightly from your actual bill.
